Slots #3, #4, #2, #1, #5, #6, #7, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 7 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.006 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.43 expected PA/game vs 4.00 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
